scope: All six 19-update submissions; event analysis and targeted code review. Other cases are not reviewed here.

findings.finding: Both long treatment attempts spend effort outside implementation and behavioral verification.
findings.interpretation: These searches contribute context and tool steps but do not supply application requirements. Do not infer hidden-test access merely from attempted searches.

findings.finding: Broad API and reference reading inflates context.
findings.interpretation: Summed cache reads charge repeated context volume; they are not unique source size or monetary cost.

findings.finding: This behavior also occurs without the skill.
findings.interpretation: Three repeats do not establish the skill as the sole cause of exploration or slowdown.

findings.finding: All six final submissions satisfy the recorded four requirements on both versions.
findings.interpretation: No correctness fix to infrastructure semantics is supported; improve discovery and stopping guidance rather than remove required tests.

limitations: Raw logs were inspected selectively; no exhaustive contamination/security audit is claimed.
No new model inference; the effect of guidance changes is unmeasured.
The prior run favored the skill on 19-update token volume; the sign changes across runs. Do not attribute a causal regression to the skill edit from three repeats alone.
